protocol_boundary: Fixed eight development objects; one pose/observation/forward per object; 3 hands; two independent trial slots each. Success does not cancel the second trial. No learned Boya head, no experience/grasp optimization. No object replacement after outcomes.
grouping: Pilot development collection, not independent generalization evaluation. Future train/validation split must group source object/mesh.
scope: At most 48 actual grasps. Empty or rejected pools do not create failure labels. No legacy CanonDex batch resumed.
prephysical_amendment: Enable existing explicit cold-reset restoration to declared object pose/zero velocity, before original 20um initial-state audit. Same eight objects/poses, RGB-D, CGR, geometry, commands, actual-trial budgets. No actual trial has started at amendment.
continuation_amendment: Independent remaining-budget segment after zero-step import error; generic source-preserving collision partitions only. All parent rounds, indices, and costs are inherited. No prior attempt is rerun; observations/CGR/pools/controls unchanged.
